main.description: Published in the account's PUBLIC repo so any sender can address MEKs to the account's latest Labyrinth epoch ([CB-19]). Works on every PDS, with or without Spaces. rkey `self` holds the latest epoch and is overwritten on rotation; rkey = epochNumber zero-padded to 12 digits holds an immutable copy of every published epoch, so senders can verify the prev_sig chain from a pinned head ([CB-29]).
